### Why two Higgs doublets in A [computed]

With only H_d (Q_H = 2), the up sector must use its conjugate H~ (Q = -2). Closure -Q_L + Q_H~ + Q_u = 0 then needs Q_u = 3, i.e. j = 3 and 7 zero modes with sigma3 = +1 (4D left-handed, the wrong chirality for u_R). So one Higgs cannot give 3 right-handed up-type modes here; A uses a second doublet H_u [assumed].

Higgs mechanism note [identity]: in 6D a scalar Yukawa between Weyl fermions of the SAME 6D chirality vanishes identically, because Gamma^0 anticommutes with Gamma_7. All fermions here have Gamma_7 = -1, so the Higgs must be an internal gauge-field component A_z (spin weight 1), i.e. gauge-Higgs unification. That is why the charge is spin-shifted.
The flux sits only in U(1)_X and no SM gauge boson carries X, so there is no Nielsen-Olesen tachyon in the W/gluon sector [standard].
Tachyon formula [computed + standard: RSS 1983]: M^2 R^2 = j(j+1) - q^2 with j >= |q| - 1. At the lowest level M^2 = -|q|/R^2 exactly, with no curvature correction.
| q | j | M^2 R^2 | degeneracy | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 2 | -3 | 5 | lowest level |
| 3 | 3 | 3 | 7 | next level |
| 3 | other helicity | 11 | - | other-helicity lowest = 3q + 2 |
q = 3 gives j = 2 with M^2 = -3/R^2 and 5 modes, j = 3 with +3/R^2; the other helicity's lowest is (3q+2)/R^2 = 11/R^2 > 0 [computed].
Tachyonic Higgs = EWSB at the compactification scale [standard: tachyonic Higgs = EWSB at the compactification scale]: the Higgs mass is tied to 1/R, so the hierarchy is unexplained.
H_u and H_d [requires gauge-Higgs embedding, not specified]: a doublet in A_M needs e.g. SU(3)_w or G2; SU(3)_w gives tree-level sin^2 theta_W = 3/4.
Yukawa = gauge coupling x 3j overlap [standard + computed], so the identical up, down and lepton matrices are a structural prediction: there is no tree-level flavour hierarchy.
There are 5 degenerate tachyonic doublets per Higgs; only the m_H = 0 vev preserves the S^2 U(1) rotation [standard].
The H_u/H_d hypercharge labels are opposite to the MSSM convention, but they are internally consistent with psi_bar_L H psi_R [identity].

Plain statement: on a round S^2, rotation symmetry (m conservation) fixes the sparsity pattern of every matrix above. Any realistic mass hierarchy needs extra [assumed] input, such as Wilson lines, a deformed metric, localised sources or a chosen Higgs vev profile. None is added here.
